title: Decider language family
statement: Given a finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with binary alphabet, define a family of four languages indexed by $j\in\{0,1,2,3\}$: in order, these are the input-length language, the language of initial codes of $N$, the language of valid steps of $N$, and the language of accepting codes of $N$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine N over the binary alphabet
An index j in a four-element set
